ui.title: The Old Courtyard
ui.lang.label: Language
hint.use_item: Use an item from your inventory
hint.key_needed: The door is locked. You need a key.
narr.intro.male: He steps into the old courtyard.
narr.intro.female: She steps into the old courtyard.
narr.table: A dusty table stands in the corner. Something glints on it.
narr.glint_revealed: You lean closer. It's an old key.
narr.chest: An old wooden chest sits against the wall.
narr.door: A heavy wooden door blocks the way out.
dialogue.guard.greet.male: Halt. You may not pass, young man.
dialogue.guard.greet.female: Halt. You may not pass, young lady.
dialogue.guard.why: Orders are orders. I don't make them.
dialogue.guard.key_hint: Ask the merchant about a key. Or check the table.
dialogue.merchant.key_pun: A key? I know a few keys — the one that opens doors, and the one that opens songs. Which one do you want?
dialogue.merchant.door_key: Then check the table over there. It's a piece of cake.
dialogue.merchant.song_key: Ha! Come back when you can pay for music.
msg.chest_opened: You open the chest. Coins glint inside.
msg.coin_edge: You flip a coin. It lands on its edge. Impressive.
msg.win: You step through the door and into the daylight. Well done, {name}!
item.old_key.name: Old Key
item.old_key.desc: A small brass key, warm to the touch.
